description: Ollama official NVIDIA GPU software support thresholds. Determines ollama_nvidia_support only; does not assess model VRAM fit.
unknown_behavior: When compute_capability is null or cannot be parsed, ollama_nvidia_support is unknown.
When driver_version is null or cannot be parsed, ollama_nvidia_support is unknown.
When nvidia-smi is missing, fails, or reports no devices, observation_status is unavailable and ollama_nvidia_support is unknown.
Do not infer compute capability or driver version from GPU product name or provider plan label.
explicit_non_scope: Does not set minimum_vram_gb, recommended_vram_gb, fit_status, or catalog model requirements.
Does not select install lane without independent OS and provider context.
Does not apply to macOS Metal/unified-memory lanes or AMD ROCm/Vulkan accelerators.
